Customer satisfaction? What a joke.
Jun 2025 • Couples
For a place that appears to pride itself on customer service, this place turned out to be a disaster. After we arrived, the music, which had been of the background variety, got louder and switched to rap mode. Boom, boom, boom. I asked the barperson who was serving us — and had done a great job to that point — if it could be turned down. Nothing happened. Boom, boom, boom. I then asked her again. “I must talk to the manager,” she said. Nothing changed. I then asked to speak to the manager, who eventually came across and said the noise level was a formula and could not be changed. “Could I ask the other patrons” — there were half a dozen — “if they’d mind?” I posited, to which he repeated that the formula must stay in place. I, and my guest, then left, chased by the mincing manager, who offered no apologies. I paid — an outrageous price considering we had had just two glasses of champagne and a mediocre martini — and we departed. And then we walked along the street and found the Stoker Woodfired Grill & Bar. It was perfect. Tasteful background music at just the right volume and fabulous food, with as good a steak as I’ve had. I guess I should have known by its name that the Trieu Institute would be prissy and pretentious, but it was beyond belief in its neglect of reasonable customer requests. In that regard, its owner and manager truly belong in an institution.

Lady Triệu
Dear mattdiebel,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We're genuinely sorry to hear that your experience with us did not reflect the level of hospitality and comfort we aim to provide.

At The Trieu Institute, we pride ourselves on everyone being welcome — and that includes making thoughtful adjustments when possible to ensure our guests feel valued. 

We curate our music, ambience, and overall experience with care - often guided by a unique concept that blends contemporary culture and Vietnamese heritage. 

That said, we understand that preferences around volume and music style can vary widely, we are sorry that your request felt dismissed, we appreciate your perspective and will improve how we accommodate requests in the future.

We're grateful for your kind words about the team member who served you initially, and we’ll be sure to share your comments with them. Regarding your notes on the drinks, we are also following up with our bar team to evaluate consistency and quality across all cocktails served.

Thank you again for your honest review. Feedback like yours plays a vital role in helping us grow, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back in the future.

Warm regards,
